Question: IS IT COMPULSARY TO COMPLETE THE ATTIYAT THOUGH THE IMAM HAS ALREADY STAND UP FOR THE SECOND RAKAT,OR ONE SHOULD LEAVE IT INCOMPLETE AND IMMEDIATELY STAND UP FOLLOWING THE IMAM FOR THE SECOND RAKAT. Answer ID: 27318 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1812/1333/D=1431) You should stand up after reciting complete Al-tahiyat. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
